```sql
WITH classic_card_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.type = 'classic'
),
accounts_by_district AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account a
),
district_names AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 AS district_name FROM district
),
all_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, district_name FROM district_names
),
owners_in_district AS (
    SELECT abo.district_id, cco.client_id
    FROM classic_card_owners cco
    JOIN accounts_by_district abo ON cco.account_id = abo.account_id
),
clients_per_district AS (
    SELECT ad.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oid.client_id) AS client_count
    FROM all_districts ad
    LEFT JOIN owners_in_district oid ON ad.district_id = oid.district_id
    GROUP BY ad.district_id
),
external_payments AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.bank, t.account, t.amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank != '' AND t.account IS NOT NULL
),
payments_joined AS (
    SELECT abo.district_id, ep.account_id, ep.bank, ep.account, ep.amount
    FROM classic_card_owners cco
    JOIN accounts_by_district abo ON cco.account_id = abo.account_id
    JOIN external_payments ep ON cco.account_id = ep.account_id
),
payments_agg AS (
    SELECT ad.district_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT pj.bank || '-' || pj.account) AS external_account_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(pj.amount), 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
    FROM all_districts ad
    LEFT JOIN payments_joined pj ON ad.district_id = pj.district_id
    GROUP BY ad.district_id
)
SELECT
    ad.district_name,
    COALESCE(cpd.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
    COALESCE(pa.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
    COALESCE(pa.total_outgoing_amount, 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
FROM
    all_districts ad
    LEFT JOIN clients_per_district cpd ON ad.district_id = cpd.district_id
    LEFT JOIN payments_agg pa ON ad.district_id = pa.district_id
ORDER BY
    pa.total_outgoing_amount DESC,
    ad.district_name ASC
;
```

SQL: WITH classic_card_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.type = 'classic'
),
accounts_by_district AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account a
),
district_names AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 AS district_name FROM district
),
all_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, district_name FROM district_names
),
owners_in_district AS (
    SELECT abo.district_id, cco.client_id
    FROM classic_card_owners cco
    JOIN accounts_by_district abo ON cco.account_id = abo.account_id
),
clients_per_district AS (
    SELECT ad.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oid.client_id) AS client_count
    FROM all_districts ad
    LEFT JOIN owners_in_district oid ON ad.district_id = oid.district_id
    GROUP BY ad.district_id
),
external_payments AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.bank, t.account, t.amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank != '' AND t.account IS NOT NULL
),
payments_joined AS (
    SELECT abo.district_id, ep.account_id, ep.bank, ep.account, ep.amount
    FROM classic_card_owners cco
    JOIN accounts_by_district abo ON cco.account_id = abo.account_id
    JOIN external_payments ep ON cco.account_id = ep.account_id
),
payments_agg AS (
    SELECT ad.district_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT pj.bank || '-' || pj.account) AS external_account_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(pj.amount), 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
    FROM all_districts ad
    LEFT JOIN payments_joined pj ON ad.district_id = pj.district_id
    GROUP BY ad.district_id
)
SELECT
    ad.district_name,
    COALESCE(cpd.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
    COALESCE(pa.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
    COALESCE(pa.total_outgoing_amount, 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
FROM
    all_districts ad
    LEFT JOIN clients_per_district cpd ON ad.district_id = cpd.district_id
    LEFT JOIN payments_agg pa ON ad.district_id = pa.district_id
ORDER BY
    pa.total_outgoing_amount DESC,
    ad.district_name ASC
LIMIT 1000

WITH german_drivers AS (
  SELECT
    driverId,
    forename,
    surname,
    dob,
    nationality,
    url
  FROM drivers
  WHERE nationality = 'German'
    AND dob BETWEEN '1971-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
),
q3_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.driverId,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url,
    d.dob,
    COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_times
  FROM german_drivers d
  LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob
)
SELECT
  forename,
  surname,
  url AS wikipedia_url,
  dob,
  q3_times
FROM q3_counts
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, dob ASC
LIMIT 1000

By 'qualify ahead of' I mean recording a better qualifying position than that driver in the same race, with a lower position number being better. The 2010 season means the races held in the year 2010.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH lucas_id AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers
  WHERE forename = 'Lucas' AND surname = 'di Grassi'
),
races_2010 AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2010'
),
lucas_qual AS (
  SELECT q1.raceId, q1.driverId, q1.position AS lucas_position
  FROM qualifying q1
  JOIN lucas_id l ON q1.driverId = l.driverId
  WHERE q1.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM races_2010)
    AND q1.position IS NOT NULL
),
drivers_2010 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q2.driverId
  FROM qualifying q2
  WHERE q2.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM races_2010)
    AND q2.position IS NOT NULL
    AND q2.driverId != (SELECT driverId FROM lucas_id)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_drivers_outqualified
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT lq.raceId, q2.driverId
  FROM lucas_qual lq
  JOIN qualifying q2 ON q2.raceId = lq.raceId
  WHERE q2.driverId != lq.driverId
    AND q2.position IS NOT NULL
    AND lq.lucas_position < q2.position
) AS outqualified_pairs;
```

  JOIN italian_gp_runners_up ru ON d.driverId = ru.driverId
)

ORDER BY num_runners_up DESC, forename ASC;

WITH drivers_with_shared_first_name AS (
  SELECT forename
  FROM drivers
  GROUP BY forename
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
target_drivers AS (
  SELECT d.driverId
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN drivers_with_shared_first_name sfn ON d.forename = sfn.forename
  WHERE d.code IS NULL
),
qualifying_under_2_min AS (
  SELECT q.*
  FROM qualifying q
  WHERE 
    q.position IS NOT NULL
    AND
      (
        CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1, 1, INSTR(q.q1, ':')-1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1, INSTR(q.q1, ':')+1) AS FLOAT)
      ) < 120
  )
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM qualifying_under_2_min q
JOIN target_drivers td ON q.driverId = td.driverId
WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(q.q1) > 0
;

WITH french_gp_editions AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    r.date AS edition_date
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.year >= 1990
    AND c.name LIKE '%Franc%'
),

  SELECT
    lt.raceId,
    lt.driverId,
    MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms
  FROM lapTimes lt
  GROUP BY lt.raceId, lt.driverId
),
fastest_lap_over_90s AS (
  SELECT
    dfl.raceId,
    dfl.driverId,
    dfl.fastest_lap_ms
  FROM driver_fastest_laps dfl
  WHERE dfl.fastest_lap_ms > 90000
),
driver_details AS (
  SELECT
    d.driverId,
    d.forename,
    d.surname
  FROM drivers d
)
SELECT
  fge.edition_date,
  dd.forename,
  dd.surname,
  CASE
    WHEN flo.raceId IS NOT NULL THEN
      printf('%d:%06.3f',
        flo.fastest_lap_ms / 60000,
        (flo.fastest_lap_ms % 60000) / 1000.0
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS fastest_lap_mss
FROM french_gp_editions fge
LEFT JOIN fastest_lap_over_90s flo ON fge.raceId = flo.raceId
LEFT JOIN driver_details dd ON flo.driverId = dd.driverId
ORDER BY
  fge.edition_date ASC,
  dd.surname ASC,
  dd.forename ASC

sql:
WITH september_2016_races AS (
    SELECT raceId, name AS race_name, circuitId, date
    FROM races
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2016' AND strftime('%m', date) = '09'
),
fastest_pitstop_ms AS (
    SELECT MIN(CAST(milliseconds AS INTEGER)) AS min_ms
    FROM pitStops
    WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM september_2016_races)
)
SELECT 
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,
    ROUND(ps.milliseconds/1000.0, 3) AS pit_stop_time_seconds,
    r.race_name,
    c.name AS circuit_name,
    c.location AS circuit_location
FROM pitStops ps
JOIN september_2016_races r ON ps.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON ps.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN fastest_pitstop_ms fpm ON CAST(ps.milliseconds AS INTEGER) = fpm.min_ms
ORDER BY driver_full_name, r.race_name, circuit_name
LIMIT 1000

    ow.driverId,

    ow.surname,
    ow.nationality,

),
first_win AS (
  SELECT
    r.name AS race_name,

WITH italian_gp AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'

    AS FLOAT) = min_q3_time
)

FROM drivers
JOIN fastest_drivers ON drivers.driverId = fastest_drivers.driverId
ORDER BY drivers.number
;

sql:
WITH chinese_gp_2000s AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.name, r.date, r.time,
         CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS hour,
         CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) AS minute
  FROM races r
  WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
    AND r.name LIKE '%Chinese Grand Prix%'
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
),
earliest_chinese_gp AS (
  SELECT cg.*
  FROM chinese_gp_2000s cg
  WHERE (cg.hour, cg.minute, cg.year) = (
    SELECT hour, minute, MAX(year)
    FROM chinese_gp_2000s
    WHERE (hour, minute) = (
      SELECT MIN(hour), MIN(minute) FROM chinese_gp_2000s
    )
  )
),
winner_and_runnerup AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    MAX(CASE WHEN res.position = 1 THEN res.driverId END) AS winner_driverId,
    MAX(CASE WHEN res.position = 2 THEN res.driverId END) AS runnerup_driverId,
    MAX(CASE WHEN res.position = 1 THEN res.time END) AS winner_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN res.position = 2 THEN res.time END) AS runnerup_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN res.position = 2 THEN res.milliseconds END) AS runnerup_ms,
    MAX(CASE WHEN res.position = 1 THEN res.milliseconds END) AS winner_ms
  FROM results res
  JOIN earliest_chinese_gp r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  GROUP BY r.raceId
)
SELECT
  egp.year AS season_year,
  CASE
    WHEN wur.runnerup_time IS NOT NULL AND wur.runnerup_time LIKE '+%' THEN wur.runnerup_time
    WHEN wur.runnerup_ms IS NOT NULL AND wur.winner_ms IS NOT NULL THEN
      printf('+%.3f', (wur.runnerup_ms - wur.winner_ms)/1000.0)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS runnerup_gap_to_winner
FROM earliest_chinese_gp egp
JOIN winner_and_runnerup wur ON egp.raceId = wur.raceId;

```sql
),
```
latest_time AS (

)
SELECT

  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef, ', ')
   FROM start_times, earliest_time
   WHERE start_time = min_time) AS earliest_circuitRefs,
  -- All circuits with the latest start time
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef, ', ')
   FROM start_times, latest_time
   WHERE start_time = max_time) AS latest_circuitRefs,
  -- Gap in seconds between earliest and latest start times
  CAST(
    (strftime('%s', (SELECT max_time FROM latest_time))
     - strftime('%s', (SELECT min_time FROM earliest_time)))
    AS INTEGER
  ) AS start_time_gap_seconds
;

WITH driver_birth_80s AS (
  SELECT driverId, forename, surname, dob
  FROM drivers
  WHERE dob BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31'
), driver_fastest_lap_speed AS (
  SELECT driverId, MAX(CAST(fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS max_fastest_lap_speed

  GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM driver_birth_80s d
JOIN driver_fastest_lap_speed f ON d.driverId = f.driverId
ORDER BY f.max_fastest_lap_speed DESC, d.dob ASC, d.surname ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH fall_2019_events AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-11-30'
),
attendance_counts AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendees
    FROM fall_2019_events e
    LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
ws_attendance AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS ws_attendees
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
      AND e.event_date BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-11-30'
    GROUP BY e.event_id
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_attendance AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendees), 1) AS avg_attendees
    FROM attendance_counts
)
SELECT
    ws.ws_attendees AS womens_soccer_attendance,
    avg_attendance.avg_attendees AS avg_event_attendance,
    CASE 
        WHEN ws.ws_attendees > avg_attendance.avg_attendees THEN 'more'
        WHEN ws.ws_attendees < avg_attendance.avg_attendees THEN 'fewer'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS verdict
FROM ws_attendance ws
CROSS JOIN avg_attendance;

WITH big_expenses AS (
  SELECT
    expense.link_to_member AS member_id,
    expense.link_to_budget AS budget_id
  FROM expense
  WHERE expense.cost > 50

  SELECT
    budget.budget_id,
    budget.remaining
  FROM budget
),
member_budget_lines AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    be.member_id,
    be.budget_id
  FROM big_expenses be
),
member_total_left AS (
  SELECT
    mbl.member_id,
    SUM(br.remaining) AS total_left
  FROM member_budget_lines mbl
  JOIN budget_remaining br ON mbl.budget_id = br.budget_id
  GROUP BY mbl.member_id
)
SELECT
  member.first_name,
  member.last_name,
  ROUND(mtl.total_left, 2) AS total_amount_left
FROM member_total_left mtl
JOIN member ON mtl.member_id = member.member_id
ORDER BY
  total_amount_left DESC,
  member.last_name ASC,
  member.first_name ASC
LIMIT 1000

  SELECT link_to_major as major_id
  FROM member
  WHERE first_name = 'Tyler' AND last_name = 'Hewitt'

all_majors AS ( -- All majors in that college
  SELECT major_id, major_name
  FROM major
  WHERE college = (SELECT college FROM tyler_college)
),
enrolled_majors AS ( -- Majors with at least one member

  FROM all_majors
  WHERE major_id NOT IN (SELECT major_id FROM enrolled_majors)
)
SELECT major_name, COUNT(*) AS major_count
FROM majors_with_no_enrollment
GROUP BY major_name;

sql:
SELECT
  maj.major_name,
  COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
FROM
  attendance att
  JOIN event ev ON att.link_to_event = ev.event_id
  JOIN member mem ON att.link_to_member = mem.member_id
  JOIN major maj ON mem.link_to_major = maj.major_id
WHERE
  ev.event_name = 'Football game'
GROUP BY
  maj.major_name
HAVING
  attendee_count = (
    SELECT
      MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM
        attendance a2
        JOIN event e2 ON a2.link_to_event = e2.event_id
        JOIN member m2 ON a2.link_to_member = m2.member_id
        JOIN major j2 ON m2.link_to_major = j2.major_id
      WHERE
        e2.event_name = 'Football game'
      GROUP BY
        j2.major_name
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  maj.major_name ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH attended_events AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name
    FROM event
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM attendance WHERE link_to_event = event.event_id
    )
),
water_expense_per_event AS (
    SELECT
        ae.event_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(x.cost), 0) AS total_water_expense
    FROM attended_events ae
    LEFT JOIN expense x
      ON x.link_to_budget = ae.event_id
      AND LOWER(x.expense_description) LIKE '%water%'
    GROUP BY ae.event_id
),
attendee_count_per_event AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
)
SELECT
    ae.event_name,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN ac.attendee_count > 0
            THEN we.total_water_expense * 1.0 / ac.attendee_count
            ELSE 0.00
        END
    , 2) AS water_spent_per_attendee
FROM attended_events ae
JOIN attendee_count_per_event ac ON ae.event_id = ac.event_id
LEFT JOIN water_expense_per_event we ON ae.event_id = we.event_id
ORDER BY ae.event_id;

```sql
    FROM event
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM attendance WHERE link_to_event = event.event_id

water_expense_per_event AS (
    SELECT
        ae.event_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(x.cost), 0) AS total_water_expense
    FROM attended_events ae
    LEFT JOIN expense x
      ON x.link_to_budget = ae.event_id
      AND LOWER(x.expense_description) LIKE '%water%'
    GROUP BY ae.event_id
),
attendee_count_per_event AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM event e

)
SELECT
    ae.event_name,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN ac.attendee_count > 0
            THEN we.total_water_expense * 1.0 / ac.attendee_count
            ELSE 0.00
        END
    , 2) AS water_spent_per_attendee
FROM attended_events ae
JOIN attendee_count_per_event ac ON ae.event_id = ac.event_id
LEFT JOIN water_expense_per_event we ON ae.event_id = we.event_id
ORDER BY ae.event_id;
```

```sql
  SELECT m.id AS member_id, major.id AS major_id, major.department_id

),
major_colleges AS (
  SELECT mm.member_id, mm.major_id, d.college_id

    GROUP BY college_id
  )
)
```

WITH purchases_in_period AS (
    SELECT 
        link_to_member AS member_id, 
        expense_description AS item, 
        SUM(cost) as total_spent
    FROM expense
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', expense_date) IN ('2019-10', '2019-11')

),
item_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        member_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS kind_count,
        SUM(total_spent) AS total_spent
    FROM purchases_in_period
    GROUP BY member_id
),
max_kinds AS (
    SELECT MAX(kind_count) AS max_kind_count FROM item_counts
)
SELECT 
    m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
    i.kind_count,
    ROUND(i.total_spent, 2) AS total_spent
FROM item_counts i
JOIN max_kinds k ON i.kind_count = k.max_kind_count
JOIN member m ON i.member_id = m.member_id
ORDER BY full_name

WHERE pph.power_count >= 10
GROUP BY g.gender

Rank heroes by height and take the top ten; if several heroes tie at the tenth-tallest height, include all of them. A hero counts among the ten tallest even if no powers are on file for them. Please give me just that single number.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH ranked_heroes AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    height,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) as rnk
  FROM superhero
),
tallest_heroes AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM ranked_heroes
  WHERE rnk <= (
    SELECT rnk
    FROM ranked_heroes
    ORDER BY rnk DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT superpower)
FROM hero_power
WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT id FROM tallest_heroes)
```

Hey, following up on my count of the God / Eternal heroes – among those who are male, what's the average number of superpowers per hero? Just give me the average rounded to two decimal places.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH god_eternal_heroes AS (
  SELECT sh.id
  FROM superhero sh
  JOIN race r ON sh.race = r.race
  WHERE r.race IN ('God / Eternal')
),
male_god_eternal_heroes AS (
  SELECT geh.id
  FROM god_eternal_heroes geh
  JOIN superhero sh ON geh.id = sh.id
  JOIN gender g ON sh.gender = g.gender
  WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
),
superpower_counts AS (
  SELECT mgeh.id, COUNT(sp.superpower) AS num_superpowers
  FROM male_god_eternal_heroes mgeh
  LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON mgeh.id = hp.hero_id
  LEFT JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power = sp.superpower
  GROUP BY mgeh.id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(num_superpowers), 2) AS avg_superpowers_per_male_god_eternal_hero
FROM superpower_counts;
```

WITH blackwulf_pub AS (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
    AND publisher_id IS NOT NULL
    LIMIT 1
),
pub_heros_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN blackwulf_pub bp ON s.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
    WHERE s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
),
other_publishers_eyes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero s
    WHERE s.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
      AND s.publisher_id <> (SELECT publisher_id FROM blackwulf_pub)
      AND s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
),
shared_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT e.eye_colour_id
    FROM pub_heros_eye_colours e

sql:
WITH full_name_heroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, g.gender
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
  WHERE s.full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
    AND g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
),
hero_power_counts AS (
  SELECT fn.id, fn.gender, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS num_powers
  FROM full_name_heroes fn
  LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON fn.id = hp.hero_id
  GROUP BY fn.id, fn.gender
)
SELECT
  gender,
  ROUND(AVG(num_powers * 1.0), 2) AS avg_superpowers_per_hero
FROM hero_power_counts
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY gender;

WITH lightest_weight AS (
  SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS min_weight
  FROM superhero
  WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
),
lightest_heroes AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE weight_kg = (SELECT min_weight FROM lightest_weight)
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(MAX(powers_count), 0) AS max_superpowers
FROM (
  SELECT h.id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS powers_count
  FROM lightest_heroes h
  LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON h.id = hp.hero_id
  GROUP BY h.id
)
;

GROUP BY c.colour
ORDER BY non_brown_hair_count DESC, c.colour ASC;

calls.content:
```sql
WITH anti_rnp_tests AS (
    SELECT
        Laboratory.Patient_ID,
        Laboratory.date AS lab_date,
        Laboratory."anti-ribonuclear protein" AS anti_rnp_value,
        Laboratory."total bilirubin" AS total_bilirubin
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Laboratory."anti-ribonuclear protein" IS NOT NULL
),
max_anti_rnp AS (
    SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_value) AS max_anti_rnp_value
    FROM anti_rnp_tests
),
strongest_anti_rnp_tests AS (
    SELECT
        t.Patient_ID,
        t.lab_date,
        t.anti_rnp_value,
        t.total_bilirubin
    FROM anti_rnp_tests t
    JOIN max_anti_rnp m
        ON t.anti_rnp_value = m.max_anti_rnp_value
    WHERE t.total_bilirubin IS NOT NULL
),
max_total_bilirubin AS (
    SELECT MAX(total_bilirubin) AS max_tb
    FROM strongest_anti_rnp_tests
)
SELECT
    s.Patient_ID,
    s.lab_date,
    s.total_bilirubin,
    p.sex,
    p.birthday
FROM strongest_anti_rnp_tests s
JOIN max_total_bilirubin tb
    ON s.total_bilirubin = tb.max_tb
JOIN Patient p
    ON s.Patient_ID = p.Patient_ID
ORDER BY s.lab_date, s.Patient_ID;
```

  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND p.Admission = 'Inpatient'

  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM FemaleInpatients)
    AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
),

  SELECT

    MAX(CAST(DNA AS REAL)) AS MaxAntiDNA
  FROM AntiDNALab

FROM AntiDNALab a
JOIN MaxAntiDNA m
  ON a.PatientID = m.PatientID AND a.DNA = m.MaxAntiDNA
ORDER BY a.PatientID, a.LaboratoryTestDate;

WITH ra_sjs_patients AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM
    Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  WHERE
    e.Diagnosis IN ('RA', 'SJS')
  GROUP BY
    p.ID
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.Diagnosis = 'RA' THEN 1 END) = 1
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.Diagnosis = 'SJS' THEN 1 END) = 1
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT e.Diagnosis) = 2
),
platelet_lab_results AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID AS patient_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN l.PLT > 100 AND l.PLT < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_normal_platelet
  FROM
    Laboratory l
  GROUP BY
    l.ID
),
classified_patients AS (
  SELECT
    p.patient_id,
    COALESCE(plr.had_normal_platelet, 0) AS had_normal_platelet
  FROM
    ra_sjs_patients p
    LEFT JOIN platelet_lab_results plr ON p.patient_id = plr.patient_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN had_normal_platelet = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
  SUM(CASE WHEN had_normal_platelet = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_without_normal_platelet
FROM
  classified_patients;

WITH sle_examinations AS (
  SELECT e.ID AS examination_id, p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON e."ID" = p."ID"

FROM abnormal_tp;

WITH thrombosis_women AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID AS Patient_ID
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
    AND (p.Diagnosis LIKE '%thrombosis%' OR p.Admission LIKE '%thrombosis%')
),
anrnp_tests AS (
  SELECT e.ID AS Patient_ID,
         e."ANA Pattern" AS Result
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e."ANA Pattern" IS NOT NULL
),
cohort_with_anrnp AS (
  SELECT t.Patient_ID,
         a.Result
  FROM thrombosis_women t
  INNER JOIN anrnp_tests a ON t.Patient_ID = a.Patient_ID
),
parsed_results AS (
  SELECT Patient_ID,
         CASE
           WHEN lower(Result) = 'negative' OR Result = '0' THEN 0
           WHEN Result LIKE '1:%' THEN
             CASE
               WHEN CAST(substr(Result, 3) AS INTEGER) > 64 THEN 1
               ELSE 0
             END
           ELSE 0
         END AS is_elevated
  FROM cohort_with_anrnp
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_elevated) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS percent_clearly_elevated
FROM parsed_results;

WITH QualifyingLab AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID AS LabID,
        l.LDH,
        l."U-PRO" AS U_PRO,
        l.Patient AS PatientID
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE
        l.LDH > 600 AND l.LDH < 800
        AND (
            -- Numeric (mg/dL) values
            (CAST(l."U-PRO" AS FLOAT) >= 300)
            OR
            -- "at least" or ">=" pattern at 300 or more
            (
                (l."U-PRO" LIKE 'at least %' OR l."U-PRO" LIKE '>=%')
                AND
                CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(l."U-PRO", 'at least ', ''), '>=', '') AS FLOAT) >= 300
            )
        )
)
SELECT
    p.ID AS PatientID,
    CAST((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INT) AS CompletedAge
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.ID IN (
    SELECT PatientID
    FROM QualifyingLab
    GROUP BY PatientID
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
)

    l."T-CHO" AS t_cho,

ORDER BY cg.admission_group DESC, cg.patient_id

JOIN max_rnp m ON CAST(a.anti_rnp_level AS FLOAT) = m.max_level
WHERE a.anti_rnp_level GLOB '[0-9]*';

WITH only_sle_patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
    AND ID NOT IN (
      SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis <> 'SLE'
    )
),
abnormal_proteinuria_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE
    -- U-PRO likely encodes proteinuria as text, so cast/convert where possible
    CASE
      WHEN typeof("U-PRO") = 'integer' OR typeof("U-PRO") = 'real'
        THEN CAST("U-PRO" AS REAL)
      WHEN "U-PRO" GLOB '*[0-9]*'
        THEN CAST("U-PRO" AS REAL)
      ELSE NULL
    END >= 30
),
patients_of_interest AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM only_sle_patients
  INTERSECT
  SELECT ID
  FROM abnormal_proteinuria_patients
),
visit_type_by_patient AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Admission = '입원' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_inpatient,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Admission = '외래' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_outpatient
  FROM
    Patient p
    INNER JOIN patients_of_interest poi ON p.ID = poi.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN ever_inpatient = 1 THEN 'Inpatient'
    ELSE 'Outpatient'
  END AS Care_Setting,
  COUNT(*) AS Patient_Count
FROM visit_type_by_patient
GROUP BY Care_Setting;

FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
AND (
    (l.FG IS NOT NULL AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450))

            l.U-PRO IN ('3', '4') -- dipstick result 3+ or 4+ encoded as '3' or '4'
            OR
            l.U-PRO LIKE '>=300%'  -- text starts with ">=300"
            OR
            (CAST(l.U-PRO AS FLOAT) >= 300)
        )
    )
)

A fibrinogen result is abnormal if it's below 150 or above 450; the normal range 150-450 is inclusive. calls.content:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS eligible_patient_count
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id
LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.patient_id = e.patient_id
WHERE p.date_of_birth > '1980-01-01'
AND (
    (l.test_name = 'fibrinogen' AND (CAST(l.result_value AS FLOAT) < 150 OR CAST(l.result_value AS FLOAT) > 450))
    OR
    (
        e.test_name = 'urinalysis_protein'
        AND (
            e.result_value IN ('3', '4') -- dipstick 3+, 4+, considered severe

            OR
            e.result_value LIKE '>=300%' -- e.g., ">=300"
            OR
            CAST(e.result_value AS FLOAT) >= 300
        )
    )
)
```

Please give me one row per patient group showing the number of lactate dehydrogenase measurements within the normal range recorded for that group, with the admitted group's row first. calls.content:
```sql
WITH cohort_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PatientID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Thrombosis = 1 AND [Autoimmune-disease] = 1
),
ldh_measurements AS (
  SELECT
    p.PatientID,
    lab.Result AS ldh_value,
    p.Admission
  FROM Laboratory lab
  JOIN cohort_patients c ON lab.PatientID = c.PatientID
  JOIN Patient p ON p.PatientID = c.PatientID
  WHERE lab.Item = 'lactate dehydrogenase'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
    WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS patient_group,
  COUNT(*) AS ldh_normal_range_count
FROM ldh_measurements
WHERE ldh_value < 500
  AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY CASE Admission WHEN '+' THEN 0 WHEN '-' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
```

WITH patients_no_sex AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX IS NULL OR SEX = ''
),
labs_with_results AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT L.ID, L.patient_id
  FROM Laboratory L
  JOIN patients_no_sex P ON L.ID = P.patient_id
),
labs_with_elevated_tb AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT L.ID, L.patient_id
  FROM Laboratory L
  JOIN patients_no_sex P ON L.ID = P.patient_id
  WHERE L.[T-BIL] >= 2.0
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM labs_with_results) AS patients_with_lab_results,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM labs_with_elevated_tb) AS patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin;

Among the patients in the thrombosis prediction data, how many have a first laboratory record showing both a normal glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase (GOT) level and an elevated anti-ribonuclear protein (RNP) concentration? By normal GOT I mean a value below 60, and by elevated RNP I mean a value above 10. By first laboratory record I mean the one with the earliest laboratory test date for that patient. I need just a single count of these patients.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
WITH FirstLab AS (
  SELECT
    Laboratory.Patient_ID,
    Laboratory.Lab_Test_Date,
    MAX(Laboratory.Lab_Test_Date) OVER(PARTITION BY Laboratory.Patient_ID) AS First_Test_Date
  FROM Laboratory
),
EarliestLab AS (
  SELECT l.Patient_ID, l.Lab_Test_Date
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT Patient_ID, MIN(Lab_Test_Date) AS First_Test_Date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY Patient_ID
  ) fl ON l.Patient_ID = fl.Patient_ID AND l.Lab_Test_Date = fl.First_Test_Date
),
GotVal AS (
  SELECT Patient_ID, Lab_Test_Date, Value AS GOT_Value
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Test_Name = 'GOT'
),
RnpVal AS (
  SELECT Patient_ID, Lab_Test_Date, Value AS RNP_Value
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Test_Name = 'RNP'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT el.Patient_ID) AS patient_count
FROM EarliestLab el
JOIN GotVal g ON el.Patient_ID = g.Patient_ID AND el.Lab_Test_Date = g.Lab_Test_Date
JOIN RnpVal r ON el.Patient_ID = r.Patient_ID AND el.Lab_Test_Date = r.Lab_Test_Date
WHERE g.GOT_Value < 60 AND r.RNP_Value > 10;
```

WITH Inpatients AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission = '+'
),
AntiDNATests AS (
  SELECT l.*, p.Diagnosis, p.Birthday
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Inpatients p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
WithLevels AS (
  SELECT *,
         CAST((julianday(Date) - julianday(Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS AgeCompletedYears
  FROM AntiDNATests
  WHERE DNA IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(DNA) != ''
  AND (CASE WHEN DNA GLOB '*[^0-9.-]*' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1 -- Numeric check, for safety
),
MaxLevel AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(DNA AS REAL)) AS MaxAntiDNALevel
  FROM WithLevels
),
TopTest AS (
  SELECT w.*
  FROM WithLevels w
  JOIN MaxLevel m ON CAST(w.DNA AS REAL) = m.MaxAntiDNALevel
  ORDER BY w.Date ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  DNA AS AntiDNAAntibodyLevel,
  AgeCompletedYears AS PatientAgeInCompletedYears,
  Diagnosis,
  Date AS TestDate
FROM TopTest;

WITH latest_igg AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    p.Admission,
    l.IGG,
    l.Date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC, l.ID DESC) AS rn
  FROM Patient p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
),
status_per_setting AS (
  SELECT 
    Admission,
    COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS total_patients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rn = 1 AND IGG IS NOT NULL AND IGG > 900 AND IGG < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal_igg_patients
  FROM latest_igg
  WHERE Admission IN ('admitted to the hospital', 'followed at the outpatient clinic')
  GROUP BY Admission
)
SELECT 
  CASE Admission 
    WHEN 'admitted to the hospital' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
    WHEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
  END AS setting,
  ROUND(100.0 * normal_igg_patients / total_patients, 1) AS percent_with_normal_IgG
FROM status_per_setting
ORDER BY setting;

```sql
WITH MostRecentVisits AS (
  SELECT
    l.Patient_ID,
    MAX(l.Visit_Date) AS Most_Recent_Visit
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.Test_Name = 'anti-RNP'
  GROUP BY l.Patient_ID
),
StronglyPositiveResults AS (

SELECT

FROM StronglyPositiveResults;
```

  SELECT l.ID AS Patient_ID, MAX(l.Date) AS Most_Recent_Date
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 32

)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Female_Male_Difference
FROM RecentStrongPosResults;

WITH female_patient_ids AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX = 'Female'
),
recent_lab AS (
  SELECT l.ID, l.Date, l.RNP, l.CPK
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN female_patient_ids p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.Date = (
      SELECT MAX(Date)
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE ID = l.ID
        AND RNP IS NOT NULL
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM recent_lab
WHERE
  CAST(RNP AS FLOAT) > 64
  AND CPK < 250;

WITH confirmed_sle_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID AS patient_id
    FROM Patient
    WHERE LOWER(Diagnosis) = 'sle'
),
inpatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id
    FROM confirmed_sle_patients p
    JOIN Patient pt ON pt.ID = p.patient_id
    WHERE LOWER(pt.Admission) = 'inpatient'
),
outpatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id
    FROM confirmed_sle_patients p
    JOIN Patient pt ON pt.ID = p.patient_id
    WHERE LOWER(pt.Admission) = 'outpatient'
),
any_setting AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM inpatients
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM outpatients
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inpatients) AS inpatients_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outpatients) AS outpatients_count,
    ROUND(
        CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inpatients) AS REAL) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM any_setting),0)
    , 2) AS inpatient_percentage
;

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  p.ID AS PatientID,
  p.SEX,
  p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l1
    WHERE l1.ID = p.ID
      AND l1.LDH >= 500
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.ID = p.ID
      AND (
        (
          -- U-PRO is a pure number and >= 100
          CASE WHEN l2.[U-PRO] GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(l2.[U-PRO] AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END >= 100
        )
        OR (
          -- U-PRO is like '+2(100)' or '+3(300)', extract number in parentheses
          l2.[U-PRO] LIKE '%(%'
          AND
            CAST(SUBSTR(l2.[U-PRO], INSTR(l2.[U-PRO], '(') + 1, INSTR(l2.[U-PRO], ')') - INSTR(l2.[U-PRO], '(') - 1) AS FLOAT) >= 100
        )
        OR (
          -- U-PRO is like '>=100' or similar
          l2.[U-PRO] LIKE '>=%' AND
            CAST(SUBSTR(l2.[U-PRO], 3) AS FLOAT) >= 100
        )
      )
)
ORDER BY p.ID;

I'm putting together a renal-involvement review. Could you pull the demographics of patients who show both marked tissue damage and clinically significant proteinuria? Specifically, I need the patient ID, sex, and birthday of every patient who has at least one LDH result of 500 or higher and at least one urinary protein result of 100 mg/dL or more. A few details: an LDH of exactly 500 counts, and a urinary protein of exactly 100 mg/dL counts. The qualifying LDH and the qualifying urinary protein don't have to come from the same lab visit. Please give me one row per patient, ordered by patient ID, and nothing beyond those three fields.

No follow-up user is available. Give the best supported answer for the question. Return your final answer as exactly one fenced SQL block containing a single read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query. Exclude intermediate SQL.

calls.content:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
  p.PatientID,
  p.Sex,
  p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l1
    WHERE l1.PatientID = p.PatientID
      AND l1.TestName = 'LDH'
      AND CAST(l1.Result AS FLOAT) >= 500
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.PatientID = p.PatientID
      AND (
        l2.TestName = 'Urinary protein'
        AND (
          -- Result is a numeric value and >= 100
          (CAST(l2.Result AS FLOAT) >= 100)
          -- or: Result is in format like '+2(100)' or higher, extract number in parentheses if present and >= 100
          OR (
            l2.Result LIKE '%(%'
            AND CAST(
              SUBSTR(
                l2.Result,
                INSTR(l2.Result, '(') + 1,
                INSTR(l2.Result, ')') - INSTR(l2.Result, '(') - 1
              ) AS FLOAT
            ) >= 100
          )
          -- or: Result is like '>=100' or higher
          OR (
            l2.Result LIKE '>=%' AND
            CAST(SUBSTR(l2.Result, 3) AS FLOAT) >= 100
          )
        )
      )
)
ORDER BY p.PatientID;
```

WITH first_presentations AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS Patient_ID,
    p.Birthday,
    MIN(e."Examination Date") AS first_visit_date
  FROM
    Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY
    p.ID,
    p.Birthday
),
feb_inpatients AS (
  SELECT
    fp.Patient_ID,
    fp.Birthday,
    fp.first_visit_date,
    e.Diagnosis
  FROM
    first_presentations fp
    JOIN Patient p2 ON fp.Patient_ID = p2.ID
    JOIN Examination e ON fp.Patient_ID = e.ID AND fp.first_visit_date = e."Examination Date"
  WHERE
    fp.first_visit_date BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28'
    AND LOWER(p2.Admission) = 'inpatient'
),
ranked_patients AS (
  SELECT
    Patient_ID,
    Diagnosis,
    JULIANDAY(first_visit_date) - JULIANDAY(Birthday) AS age_days
  FROM
    feb_inpatients
)
SELECT
  Diagnosis
FROM
  ranked_patients
ORDER BY
  age_days DESC,
  Patient_ID ASC
LIMIT 1;

I'm auditing inpatient intake during the February 1998 admission wave. Among patients first seen at the hospital in the second half of February 1998 (visit date from 15 to 28 February 1998), find the oldest inpatient at first presentation and give me that patient's diagnosis only. If two patients tie in age, use the one with the smaller patient ID.

```sql
WITH first_presentations AS (
  SELECT
    p.Patient_ID,
    p.DOB,
    MIN(e.Date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM
    Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.Patient_ID = e.Patient_ID
  GROUP BY
    p.Patient_ID,
    p.DOB
),
feb_inpatients AS (
  SELECT
    fp.Patient_ID,
    fp.DOB,
    fp.first_visit_date,
    e.Diagnosis,
    e.Admission_Type
  FROM
    first_presentations fp
    JOIN Examination e

    fp.first_visit_date BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28'
    AND (LOWER(e.Admission_Type) = 'inpatient')
),
ranked_patients AS (
  SELECT
    Patient_ID,
    Diagnosis,
    -- Age in days at first presentation (using July 1 to compare age precisely)

  FROM
    feb_inpatients
)
SELECT
  Diagnosis
FROM
  ranked_patients
ORDER BY
  age_days DESC,
  Patient_ID ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

WITH alt_status AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID AS PatientID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN l.GPT >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_abnormal_alt
  FROM Laboratory l
  GROUP BY l.ID

  FROM Patient p
  LEFT JOIN alt_status a ON p.ID = a.PatientID
)
SELECT 
  SEX, 
  COUNT(*) AS num_patients
FROM patient_status
WHERE had_abnormal_alt = 0
  AND SEX IN ('male', 'female')
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX

WITH rbc_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID AS PatientID
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.RBC < 3.5
),
setting_status AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS PatientID,
    CASE 
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM Examination e
        WHERE e.ID = p.ID AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%입원%'
      ) THEN '+'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM Examination e
        WHERE e.ID = p.ID AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%외래%'
      ) THEN '-'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS CareSetting
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT PatientID FROM rbc_patients)
),
age_calc AS (
  SELECT
    s.CareSetting,
    p.ID AS PatientID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) - 
      (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS CompletedAge
  FROM setting_status s
  JOIN Patient p ON s.PatientID = p.ID
  WHERE s.CareSetting IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
  CareSetting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PatientID) AS PatientCount,
  ROUND(AVG(CompletedAge), 1) AS AverageCompletedAge
FROM age_calc
GROUP BY CareSetting
ORDER BY CareSetting

sql:
WITH patients_with_normal_anti_sm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE (SM = 'negative' OR SM = '0')
),
patients_without_thrombosis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Thrombosis = 0 OR Thrombosis IS NULL
),
patients_with_significant_proteinuria AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE (
    [U-PRO] NOT IN ('-', 'TR')
    AND CASE WHEN [U-PRO] GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST([U-PRO] AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END >= 30
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM patients_with_normal_anti_sm p
JOIN patients_without_thrombosis t ON p.ID = t.ID
JOIN patients_with_significant_proteinuria s ON p.ID = s.ID;

WITH molecules_with_single_bond AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxygen_atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        mwsb.molecule_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_oxygen_atoms
    FROM molecules_with_single_bond mwsb
    LEFT JOIN atom a ON mwsb.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    GROUP BY mwsb.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(num_oxygen_atoms * 1.0), 4) AS avg_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule
FROM oxygen_atom_counts;

FROM label_stats
GROUP BY group_type;

WITH carcinogenic_mols AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '+'
),
molecule_elements AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, element
    FROM atom
),
unique_elem_mols AS (
    SELECT me1.molecule_id, me1.element
    FROM molecule_elements me1
    LEFT JOIN molecule_elements me2
      ON me1.element = me2.element
     AND me1.molecule_id <> me2.molecule_id
    WHERE me2.molecule_id IS NULL
),
qualifying_mols AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ue.molecule_id
    FROM unique_elem_mols ue
    JOIN carcinogenic_mols cm ON ue.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
)
SELECT bond_id, molecule_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM qualifying_mols);

WITH n_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'n'

all_n_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM n_atoms

  SELECT n.molecule_id

  WHERE b.bond_type IS NULL OR b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY n.molecule_id, n.atom_id
  HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IS NOT NULL AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_molecules
FROM all_n_molecules m
JOIN n_singlebond_only_molecules nsb
  ON m.molecule_id = nsb.molecule_id;

sql:
WITH carbon_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_carbons
  FROM atom a
  WHERE a.element = 'C'
  GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
chlorine_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_chlorines
  FROM atom a
  WHERE a.element = 'Cl'
  GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
atom_counts AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
  FROM atom a
  GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_bonds
  FROM bond b
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
carbon_touching_bonds AS (
  -- carbon-touching: a bond where either atom is a carbon (count bond once if both are carbon)
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id AND b.bond_id = b.bond_id AND a1.element = 'C'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
multiple_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS num_multiple_bonds
  FROM bond b
  WHERE b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
with_ranking AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity,
    COALESCE(ac.num_atoms, 0) AS num_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.num_bonds, 0) AS num_bonds,
    COALESCE(ca.num_carbons, 0) AS num_carbons,
    COALESCE(cl.num_chlorines, 0) AS num_chlorines,
    COALESCE(ctb.num_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
    COALESCE(mb.num_multiple_bonds, 0) AS num_multiple_bonds
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN carbon_atoms ca ON m.molecule_id = ca.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN chlorine_atoms cl ON m.molecule_id = cl.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN atom_counts ac ON m.molecule_id = ac.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON m.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN carbon_touching_bonds ctb ON m.molecule_id = ctb.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN multiple_bonds mb ON m.molecule_id = mb.molecule_id
  WHERE COALESCE(ca.num_carbons, 0) >= 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY num_carbon_touching_bonds DESC, num_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank,
  molecule_id,
  carcinogenicity,
  num_atoms,
  num_bonds,
  num_carbons,
  num_chlorines,
  num_carbon_touching_bonds,
  num_multiple_bonds
FROM with_ranking
ORDER BY rank
LIMIT 1000

arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    x.element AS element, 
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN (
    SELECT b.bond_id, a1.atom_id AS c_id, a2.atom_id AS x_id, a2.element
    FROM bond b
    JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
    WHERE (a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element != 'C') OR (a2.element = 'C' AND a1.element != 'C')
) x ON b.bond_id = x.bond_id 
WHERE m.label = '-' AND (b.bond_type = 'double' OR b.bond_type = 'triple')
GROUP BY x.element
ORDER BY count DESC;

WITH mol_info AS (
  SELECT label AS carcinogenicity_label
  FROM molecule
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
),
bond_summary AS (
  SELECT
    bond.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
    COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
    COUNT(DISTINCT atom1.element || '-' || atom2.element) AS num_element_pairs
  FROM bond
  JOIN atom AS atom1 ON bond.molecule_id = atom1.molecule_id AND substr(bond.bond_id, 1, instr(bond.bond_id, '-')-1) = atom1.atom_id
  JOIN atom AS atom2 ON bond.molecule_id = atom2.molecule_id AND substr(bond.bond_id, instr(bond.bond_id, '-')+1) = atom2.atom_id
  WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND bond.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
  GROUP BY bond_kind_symbol
)
SELECT
  b.bond_kind_symbol,
  b.num_bonds,
  b.num_element_pairs,
  m.carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_summary b
CROSS JOIN mol_info m
ORDER BY b.num_bonds DESC, b.bond_kind_symbol ASC;
